prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas of 2D platform-game terrain for seven original cozy fantasy worlds. EXACT layout: two equal columns and seven equal rows on a 2:3 portrait canvas, fourteen cells, no labels or separators. Every cell uses the same baseline and scale. Leave a clear transparent margin inside each cell so assets do not overlap. Left column in each row: one broad straight horizontal ground strip, flat walking surface along the top, 3 times wider than tall, grass/stone cap and exposed soil/rock underneath, left and right edges tileable. Right column: one broad horizontal floating platform with flat top, natural rounded/tapered earthy underside, 5 times wider than tall, isolated with transparent air above and below. Row 1 sunny meadow: soft green grass, small white daisies, warm ochre soil and small stones. Row 2 woodland: rich moss, fern edges, tangled tree roots and dark brown soil. Row 3 moonlit harbor: blue-gray stone quay, worn paving top, barnacles, cool stone blocks and tiny moss. Row 4 enchanted secret forest: teal moss, violet crystals, tiny luminous mushrooms, charcoal rocks. Row 5 desert: pale gold sand cap, layered terracotta sandstone and small pebbles. Row 6 farm: green turf edge, tilled brown earth with roots and pebbles. Row 7 village market: warm beige cobblestone top, brick foundation with subtle green moss. Style: detailed crisp hand-pixelled 16-bit RPG terrain sprites, deliberate square pixel clusters, matching a dreamy pixel village game. Straight side view, orthographic, NOT isometric. Every platform top remains clear enough to stand on; embellishments small and to sides. No characters, scenery, sky, UI, text, shadows outside sprite or checkerboard. Actual transparent background.
